scripts.infra:up: docker compose --profile storage up -d --build --wait postgres redis minio
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:shared && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @dineflow/shared test && pnpm --filter @dineflow/api test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @dineflow/api test:integration
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
